name: NightFlight Expedition
description: NightFlight Expedition is Dollywood's newest ride, opened on 19 August 2026. It is an indoor hybrid that combines a coaster with a whitewater-style river ride, with 1,255 ft (382 m) of track and a top speed of about 29 mph (47 km/h). The thrill level is moderate, so it suits most of the family. Min 99cm.

name: Big Bear Mountain
description: Big Bear Mountain is a family-friendly coaster that opened on 12 May 2023. Three separate launches send the train along 66 ft (20 m) high track at up to 48 mph (77 km/h), with a moderate thrill level that suits kids and adults alike. Min 99cm.

name: Lightning Rod
description: Lightning Rod is a launched wooden roller coaster that opened on 13 June 2016. The train is shot out of the station at up to 73 mph (117 km/h), climbs to 206 ft (63 m) and plunges down a 165 ft (50 m) drop, over 3,800 ft (1,200 m) of track. It is the park's headline thrill ride. Min 122cm.

name: Wild Eagle
description: Wild Eagle is a wing coaster that opened on 24 March 2012. Riders sit on either side of the track with nothing above or below them as the train rises to 210 ft (64 m), drops 135 ft (41 m) and reaches 61 mph (98 km/h), flipping through four inversions above the Smoky Mountain treetops. Min 127cm, max 198 cm.

name: Thunderhead
description: Thunderhead is a classic wooden roller coaster that opened on 3 April 2004. The track rises to about 100 ft (30 m) with a 100 ft drop and reaches 55 mph (88 km/h), with the airtime and rumble that wooden coasters are loved for. Min 122cm.

name: Tennessee Tornado
description: Tennessee Tornado is a steel looping coaster that opened on 17 April 1999. The train climbs to 163 ft (50 m), drops 128 ft (39 m) and reaches about 63 mph (101 km/h) before flipping riders through three inversions. Min 122cm.

name: Mystery Mine
description: Mystery Mine is a steel coaster that opened on 13 April 2007, running partly indoors through a themed mine and partly outdoors. A Gerstlauer Eurofighter with an 85 ft (26 m) drop, it reaches 43 mph (69 km/h) and includes two inversions. Min 122cm.

name: FireChaser Express
description: FireChaser Express is a dual-launch family coaster that opened on 22 March 2014. The train is launched along a 78 ft (24 m) high layout and reaches 35 mph (56 km/h), giving younger riders a real coaster experience. Min 99cm.

name: Dragonflier
description: Dragonflier is a family suspended coaster that opened on 10 May 2019. The train hangs beneath the track and swings through a seven-story first drop into a tunnel, reaching 46.6 mph (75 km/h) on a layout 63 ft (19 m) high. Min 99cm, max 206 cm.

name: Drop Line
description: Drop Line is a 200 ft (61 m) drop tower that opened on 6 May 2017 and replaced the old Timber Tower. Riders are lifted high above the park for far-reaching views before dropping in free fall. Min 140cm.

name: The Barnstormer
description: The Barnstormer is a giant swing from S&S Worldwide that opened on 28 March 2011. Riders swing back and forth in an arc that takes them up to 81 ft (25 m) in the air at speeds of up to 45 mph (72 km/h). Min 122cm.

name: Smoky Mountain River Rampage
description: Smoky Mountain River Rampage is a whitewater raft ride that has been part of the park since 1986. Rafts spin and bounce down a rushing river, so expect to get wet, especially on hot days. Min 91cm; children under 122 cm need a companion aged 14 or older.

name: Daredevil Falls
description: Daredevil Falls is a flume boat ride that opened on 18 April 1998, ending with a 60 ft (18 m) plunge at about 50 mph (80 km/h). Closed for the rest of the 2026 season; check the park for its return. Min 107cm.
statusNote: Closed for the rest of the 2026 season.

name: Whistle Punk Chaser
description: Whistle Punk Chaser is a junior coaster that opened on 21 May 2017, a gentle first roller coaster for younger children. Min 91cm.

name: Blazing Fury
description: Blazing Fury is an enclosed dark-ride coaster that opened on 6 June 1978, making it one of the park's classics. It reopened in July 2025 after a refurbishment. Min 107cm.
